sql: SELECT 'Amherst' AS city, TRY_CAST(Jun AS DOUBLE) AS jun, TRY_CAST(Jul AS DOUBLE) AS jul, TRY_CAST(Aug AS DOUBLE) AS aug, TRY_CAST(Jun AS DOUBLE)+TRY_CAST(Jul AS DOUBLE)+TRY_CAST(Aug AS DOUBLE) AS summer_2015_rainfall FROM monthly_precipitations_amherst WHERE Year = '2015' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ashburnham', TRY_CAST(Jun AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(Jul AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(Aug AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(Jun AS DOUBLE)+TRY_CAST(Jul AS DOUBLE)+TRY_CAST(Aug AS DOUBLE) FROM monthly_precipitations_ashburnham WHERE Year = '2015' UNION ALL SELECT 'Boston', TRY_CAST(Jun AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(Jul AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(Aug AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(Jun AS DOUBLE)+TRY_CAST(Jul AS DOUBLE)+TRY_CAST(Aug AS DOUBLE) FROM monthly_precipitations_boston WHERE Year = '2015' UNION ALL SELECT 'Chatham', TRY_CAST(Jun AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(Jul AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(Aug AS DOUBLE), TRY_CAST(Jun AS DOUBLE)+TRY_CAST(Jul AS DOUBLE)+TRY_CAST(Aug AS DOUBLE) FROM monthly_precipitations_chatham WHERE Year = '2015'

SELECT "Community" AS community, "Beach Name" AS beach_name, COUNT(*) AS samples, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Violation") AS violation_count, ROUND(AVG("Indicator Level"), 2) AS avg_indicator_level, MAX("Indicator Level") AS max_indicator_level FROM water_body_testing_2015 WHERE "Community" ILIKE '%chatham%' GROUP BY "Community", "Beach Name" ORDER BY avg_indicator_level DESC
